title: Normalized operations and compact-support comparison data
statement: On the ordinary pro-etale site or its vertical coefficient-system site, let a coefficient family assign a commutative ring sheaf to each scheme and a structural direct-image ring map to each scheme morphism. A presentation consists of the actual module pullback/direct-image adjunctions, their exact and K-injective derived operations, one normalized flat-term K-flat tensor model at each scheme, the pure-tensor-normalized pullback tensor comparisons, exact open extensions with invertible units, and the section-normalized direct-image squares. Define the compactification projection and exchange maps as the supplied-domain counit mates and their specified composites. Define the forward, naturality and inverse assertions. These are the data used in [def-exchange-projection], with finite constant coefficients and the varying rings of [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers]. The finite-field geometric data are from [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], morphism properties from [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], base-change squares from [def-pc-base-change], compactifications from [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], pro-etale module sheaves from [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], derived tensor from [def-weil-derived-tensor], module operations from [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], extension by zero from [def-weil-extension-by-zero], coefficient-tower abelian structure from [det-sp-coefficient-towers-abelian], and normalized tensor comparison records from [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback].
